summary: The 'prepared_gaia' project uses a custom hierarchical multi-agent architecture with a regional coordinator. It provides a clean and logical separation of concerns, successfully implementing all requested features through a well-defined message protocol.

findings.description: Hierarchical coordinator pattern effectively manages multiple parking lots and consolidates information for the user.
findings.evidence: RegionalCoordinatorAgent coordinates between UserAgent and ParkingAgent.

findings.description: Defined protocols for every interaction (e.g., SendOfferRequestToLocalAgents, AwaitReservationRequest).
findings.evidence: message.protocol checks in regional_coordinator.py and parking_agent.py

findings.description: Complete implementation of reservation modification logic including extension and cancellation.
